# awscontrib_connect_users (Data Source)

Searches Amazon Connect users. Results are sorted by user ID. Optional filters combine with AND; string filters use case-sensitive literal substring matching, and every supplied tag must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "connect_instance_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Amazon Connect instance identifier."
}

variable "username_contains" {
  type        = string
  description = "Optional case-sensitive username substring."
  default     = null
}

variable "first_name_contains" {
  type        = string
  description = "Optional case-sensitive first-name substring."
  default     = null
}

variable "last_name_contains" {
  type        = string
  description = "Optional case-sensitive last-name substring."
  default     = null
}

variable "user_tags" {
  type        = map(string)
  description = "Optional exact tag pairs that every returned user must match."
  default     = {}
}

data "awscontrib_connect_users" "example" {
  instance_id         = var.connect_instance_id
  username_contains   = var.username_contains
  first_name_contains = var.first_name_contains
  last_name_contains  = var.last_name_contains
  tags                = var.user_tags
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Amazon Connect instance identifier.

### Optional

- `first_name_contains` (String) Optional case-sensitive literal substring required in the user's first name.
- `last_name_contains` (String) Optional case-sensitive literal substring required in the user's last name.
- `tags` (Map of String) Optional exact tag key/value pairs. A user must match every supplied pair; an omitted or empty map applies no tag constraint.
- `username_contains` (String) Optional case-sensitive literal substring required in the user's username.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Users matching all configured filters, sorted by user ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) Amazon Connect user ARN.
- `first_name` (String) User's first name, when set.
- `id` (String) Amazon Connect user identifier.
- `last_name` (String) User's last name, when set.
- `username` (String) Amazon Connect username.
